verdict.rationale: Railway's own marketing copy directly claims you can run your application closer to your users, which is the core of this story. That is the only evidence: a single one-line statement, with nothing showing how to choose a specific region or which regions exist. missing for 10: documentation of selectable regions and the region list, how to configure per-service or multi-region deploys, latency or placement details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can deploy my application to specific regions closer to my users

citations.quote: Run your application closer to where your users are.
